Scorching afternoon
on cultural day at orientation camp

This is a small corner of the internet built for one person — because some things are worth saying properly, not just texting.

the first thing I noticed

I met you at camp, and I've thought about that first conversation more times than I'll admit. There's a way you carry yourself — unhurried, sure of who you are — that I haven't stopped noticing since and stress free.

This isn't a line. It's just true: you are the most beautiful woman I have ever seen. Not because of just beautiful face or photo, but because of how it all comes together — how you look, how you laugh, how you beautify the environment you are and put smile on people through your beauty.

Do you believed I Searched "the most beautiful woman" and somehow, the internet already knows no other person deserve the crown than you.

To WEYINMI —

I've rewritten this a few times, because I wanted it to sound like me and not like a card from a shop. So here it is, plainly: meeting you at camp is one of those moments I can point to and say — that's when I start to enjoy camp. Being seeing you around and can't forget our first conversation

You have a way of making ordinary minutes feel worth remembering and that's why i always wish you come around but sleep is more powerful. I notice it in small things like when you make that beautiful smile, how your laugh arrives a beat before you expect it to, how you seem entirely unbothered by trying to impress anyone, which somehow makes you more impressive.

I built this page because texting it felt too small for how I actually feel. I hope it makes you smile the way you make everyone around you smile.

— written with more nerves than I'll admit
